message.content:
The image displays a 3D model of an **E-101 Waste Heat Boiler**, specifically a **shell-and-tube heat exchanger**. The cylindrical, metallic object **rests on the dark grid ground** via small support feet.

Visible **UI elements** include a header with the component name and navigation arrow, a top-left breadcrumb trail ("3D COMPONENT MODEL • E-101 • REAL SCALE"), and a toggle switch in the top-right corner for **"ASSEMBLED"** (selected) and **"CUTAWAY"** views. An information panel in the bottom-left describes the component's function.

The **nozzles** on top of the machine are colored **green** and **red**. There is also a smaller red nozzle visible at the bottom front of the vessel.
